en.name: ESIC (Employees' State Insurance)
en.description: Social security and health insurance scheme for workers in covered establishments (medical, sickness, maternity, disability benefits).
en.eligibility: Employees with wage up to Rs. 21,000/month (Rs. 25,000 for persons with disability) in ESIC-covered factories/establishments.
en.benefits: Cashless medical care for worker and family, sickness/maternity benefits, disability and dependent benefits.
application_steps: Employer registers establishment and enrols employees (Form 1).
Avail treatment at ESIC dispensary/hospital with card.
faqs: What is the wage ceiling for ESIC?
What is the ESIC wage limit?
How do I get a Pehchan card?
How do I claim ESIC sickness benefit?
